result.title: Anomaly Detection on Resource-Constrained Devices with Reservoir Computing
result.summary: Anomaly detection at the edge requires the deployment of models that achieve competitive performance, while minimizing computational cost and memory footprint. In this article, we investigate the suitability of the Mahalanobis Distance of Reservoir States (MDRS), an unsupervised time-series anomaly detection method, for resource-constrained devices and propose two optimizations to reduce its computational requirements. Specifically, we replace random reservoir connectivity (MDRS-Rand) with a circular shift (MDRS-Circ) and show that the anomaly score for an entire time series can be computed from the final reservoir state alone. Furthermore, we show that exploiting the reservoir's temporal memory enables more efficient input preprocessing, further reducing computational cost. We evaluate the MDRS variants on the MLPerf Tiny anomaly detection benchmark against the reference autoencoder and other anomaly detection methods, and deploy their inference kernels on a NUCLEO-F401RE microcontroller to assess latency, estimate energy consumption, and measure memory footprint. Among the evaluated methods, only MDRS and the autoencoder meet the benchmark's performance target, with MDRS requiring fewer operations and smaller models. With optimized preprocessing, MDRS achieves an ROC AUC of 0.869, a model size of 24 KB, an estimated energy consumption of 24 uJ per inference, and a latency of 0.32 ms, corresponding to a 75.9x speedup over the autoencoder with standard preprocessing.

AI.brief_summary: 论文研究储层状态马氏距离（MDRS）这一无监督时序异常检测方法在资源受限设备上的适用性，提出用环形移位连接替代随机储层连接，并证明整段序列的异常分数可仅由最终储层状态计算，在 MLPerf Tiny 基准与微控制器上评估精度、时延、能耗与内存。
AI.relevance_reason: 储层状态是固定、不训练的循环隐状态，「整段序列分数仅由最终状态得出」可供核查 LVR 中 latent 状态压缩与停止判据的线索；其循环状态更新的算力与内存折中也可能类比 latent 推理的效率权衡，但论文本身不含视觉或多模态推理内容。
